text: I recently ordered Tala Hua Gosht and Khatti Daal from Hussain Catering. Looking at the pictures the food looked very yummy and appealing but unfortunately my actual experience was very disappointing. The Tala Hua Gosht was especially concerning. Many of the bones were very large and fatty and based on their appearance and texture they did not look like the kind of mutton pieces I was expecting. While chewing some of the fatty/meaty texture would even get stuck in the teeth which was very unpleasant. The most concerning part was after keeping the food in the refrigerator for a while. The appearance and texture changed in a way that made me uncomfortable eating it myself and I definitely did not feel comfortable serving it to my children. For a moment the quality reminded me of very inexpensive restaurant food rather than the quality I expected from Hussain Catering. I am sharing this review not to damage the business but because Hussain Catering has a name in the Lombard community and I sincerely hope they maintain that reputation. I understand businesses get busy and want to expand but please do not compromise on the quality of the food. Customers trust you when they order food for their families. Please take this feedback seriously and maintain consistent quality especially with the meat being served.
label: negative
